[[Droid/Legends|Droids]] were equipped with an internal '''guidance system''' to assist with navigation. However, provided they could get through the droid's access codes, the system could be accessed by an enemy through a [[Robolobotomy/Legends|robolotomy]].<ref name="TD" />
